items.title: Unitree's STAR Board IPO Registration Approved — First Humanoid Robot Company to Go Public Globally
items.title_zh: 宇树科技科创板IPO注册获批，成为全球首家人形机器人上市公司
items.summary: The China Securities Regulatory Commission approved Unitree's IPO registration on the STAR Board on July 2, making it the first humanoid robot company globally to go public. The process from application acceptance to approval took just 104 days, and Unitree is the first humanoid robot firm to achieve scaled profitability before IPO.

items.title: Kuaishou's Kling AI Raises Nearly $3 Billion at $18 Billion Valuation
items.title_zh: 快手可灵AI完成近30亿美元融资，估值达180亿美元
items.summary: Kling AI, Kuaishou's AI video generation platform, raised nearly $3 billion in external funding on July 2. The round was co-led by CPE, Guofang Venture Capital, BlueFive, and Tencent, with a post-money valuation of $18 billion. The financing supports Kling AI's transition to independent commercial operations.

items.title: Microsoft Launches Its Own AI Deployment Company with $2.5 Billion Commitment
items.title_zh: 微软成立AI部署公司，承诺投入25亿美元
items.summary: Microsoft has launched a new AI deployment group backed by a $2.5 billion commitment, following similar moves by Amazon, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The initiative underscores the intensifying race among tech giants to build dedicated infrastructure for enterprise AI deployment.

items.title: Anthropic Is Discussing a New Custom Chip with Samsung
items.title_zh: Anthropic正与三星洽谈定制AI芯片合作
items.summary: Anthropic is in discussions with Samsung to develop a new custom AI chip, coming about a week after OpenAI announced its own custom chip partnership with Broadcom. This signals a broader trend of AI labs moving toward in-house silicon to reduce reliance on NVIDIA.

items.title: OpenAI Proposes Donating 5% of Its Equity to a US Sovereign Wealth Fund
items.title_zh: OpenAI提议将5%股权捐赠给美国主权财富基金
items.summary: CEO Sam Altman has reportedly proposed giving 5% of OpenAI's equity to a U.S. sovereign wealth fund, reviving discussions about letting the public share in the financial gains from the AI boom. The proposal comes amid ongoing talks with the Trump administration.

items.title: Google Loses Appeal of Record EU Fine, Must Pay $4.7 Billion
items.title_zh: 谷歌上诉失败，须支付欧盟47亿美元创纪录罚单
items.summary: Google lost its long-running appeal of a record EU antitrust fine over the practice of bundling its search engine and browser with Android. The $4.7 billion penalty, originally imposed by the European Commission, has now been conclusively upheld.

items.title: Alibaba Bans All Anthropic Products Effective July 10, Citing Model Distillation Concerns
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴禁止员工使用Anthropic产品，7月10日起生效
items.summary: Alibaba has issued an internal ban on all Anthropic Claude models and agent products, effective July 10, following accusations of model distillation attacks. The move reflects escalating tensions between Chinese and US AI companies over intellectual property and model security.

items.title: Tech Giants Flood Into Embodied Intelligence as the Battle Heats Up
items.title_zh: 科技巨头涌入具身智能赛道，竞争全面升温
items.summary: Li Auto, Alibaba, ByteDance, and other tech giants are entering the embodied intelligence race. Morgan Stanley projects 2.8 million humanoid robot sales in China by 2026, indicating the market is rapidly moving from R&D to commercial deployment.

items.title: Elon Musk Shuts Down '4D Chess' Theory on Tesla Optimus Production
items.title_zh: 马斯克否认Optimus「四维象棋」理论，称人形机器人初期产量极低
items.summary: Elon Musk directly rejected a popular theory that Tesla is secretly further ahead on Optimus than it reveals, warning that production of its humanoid robot "will be extremely slow at first." The comment cuts against a bullish narrative that Tesla's quiet stretch on Optimus is a strategic deception.

items.title: Meta Quietly Launches Vibe-Coded Gaming App Pocket
items.title_zh: Meta悄然推出氛围编程游戏应用Pocket
items.summary: Meta has quietly launched Pocket, an experimental AI app that lets users generate and share interactive mini games using text prompts. The launch reflects Meta's push toward consumer-facing AI-generated interactive experiences.

items.title: IQM, Europe's First Public Quantum Company, Goes Public on Nasdaq at $1.9 Billion
items.title_zh: 欧洲首家上市量子公司IQM登陆纳斯达克，估值19亿美元
items.summary: Finland-based IQM, a full-stack quantum computing company, went public on the Nasdaq at a valuation of approximately $1.9 billion, becoming Europe's first publicly traded quantum company. The company noted that the future of quantum technology remains uncertain.

items.title: Tesla Caps Employee AI Spending at $200 per Week, Except for Grok
items.title_zh: 特斯拉限制员工AI使用费至每周200美元，Grok除外
items.summary: Tesla will impose a $200-per-week limit on employee AI spending starting July 6, according to an internal memo reported by The Information. The cap comes months after Tesla pushed employees to use AI more aggressively, highlighting how even AI-invested companies struggle to control costs.

items.title: Tesla Driver Faces Manslaughter Charges over FSD Crash That Killed a Woman
items.title_zh: 特斯拉司机因FSD模式下撞死民宅内女性面临过失杀人指控
items.summary: Michael Butler, 44, is facing manslaughter charges after his Tesla Model 3 struck and killed a woman inside her Texas home. Butler claimed he was driving using Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system at the time of the crash, raising renewed questions about FSD safety and liability.

items.title: US Government Says It Got Hacked — Again, DHS Intelligence Network Compromised
items.title_zh: 美国政府再次遭黑客攻击，国土安全部情报网络被入侵
items.summary: A top Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee warned that information accessed on a Homeland Security intelligence-sharing network may risk national security. This is the latest in a series of breaches targeting US government systems.

items.title: Google's AI Buildout Drove 37% Increase in Electricity Use in 2025
items.title_zh: 谷歌AI基础设施建设致2025年电力消耗增长37%
items.summary: Google's AI data center expansion drove a 37% increase in electricity use in 2025, as the company attempts to balance its growing AI infrastructure needs with clean energy commitments. The surge highlights the environmental costs of the AI arms race.

sections.label: China Tech News / 中国科技新闻

items.title: Humanoid Robots Enter the Frontline: From Show Floor to Factory Floor as Star Employees
items.title_zh: 人形机器人走进一线：从展会舞台到工厂核心岗位
items.summary: Humanoid robots are transitioning from demonstrations to real workplaces across China, with robots deployed in factories and logistics centers reaching 85% of human efficiency. The shift signals a new phase in industrial robotics where humanoid forms are proving commercially viable.

items.title: Chinese Tech Giants Race to Match Claude Code as Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance Join the Fray
items.title_zh: 中国科技巨头竞逐Claude Code：阿里、腾讯、字节跳动纷纷入局
items.summary: Tencent, Alibaba, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Zhipu AI have all launched competing AI coding agents, betting on localized workflows to challenge Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's offerings. The race reflects the strategic importance of developer tools in the AI competition.

items.title: From Lab to Trillion-Dollar Market: The Parallel Rise of Zhipu AI and Galaxy General
items.title_zh: 从实验室到万亿市场：智谱AI与银河通用的并行崛起
items.summary: Beijing's two 'AI dragon heads' — Zhipu AI in digital intelligence and Galaxy General in embodied robotics — are charting parallel paths toward Artificial General Intelligence. Both companies have seen rapid valuation growth and are positioning themselves as leaders in their respective AI domains.

items.title: China's Domestic AI Compute Revolution Reaches a Tipping Point
items.title_zh: 中国国产AI算力革命达到拐点
items.summary: China's domestic AI compute industry has reached a tipping point as ByteDance, Alibaba, and Baidu pivot to domestic chips. The domestic GPU share now stands at 41% of new deployments, signaling a structural shift in China's AI infrastructure away from reliance on foreign hardware.

items.title: China's AI Compute Shortage: The Real Problem Isn't Oversupply But Something More Dangerous
items.title_zh: 中国AI算力短缺：真正的问题不是供过于求，而是结构错配
items.summary: Despite claims of 80% idle data center capacity in China, the AI compute landscape faces a structural mismatch where effective capacity lags far behind paper capacity. The real bottleneck lies not in total compute volume but in the quality and interconnect capabilities of available chips.

items.title: Inside Huaqiangbei's AI Hardware Boom: Four Kings and Budget Products Conquering the Mass Market
items.title_zh: 华强北AI硬件热潮：四大品类低价产品占领大众市场
items.summary: Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei electronics market is experiencing an AI hardware boom, with four product categories dominating: AI glasses, watches, companion toys, and smart rings. Prices start as low as 100 yuan, making AI wearables accessible to the mass consumer market.

items.title: CAS Institute of Software Launches Reasoning Lens, Making AI Model Thinking Processes Visible
items.title_zh: 中科院软件所发布Reasoning Lens，让AI模型推理过程可视化
items.summary: Researchers at the Chinese Academy of Sciences have developed Reasoning Lens, a system that visualizes and diagnoses AI reasoning chains. The tool aims to address the transparency burden of large language models by making their internal decision processes observable and auditable.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc — Use Codex from Claude Code to Review Code or Delegate Tasks
items.title_zh: openai/codex-plugin-cc — 在Claude Code中使用Codex审查代码或委派任务
items.summary: OpenAI released an open-source plugin that allows developers to use Codex directly within Claude Code, enabling cross-model code review and task delegation between the two AI coding assistants.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp — Chrome DevTools for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp — 面向编码代理的Chrome开发者工具
items.summary: Google released an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that integrates Chrome DevTools with coding agents, enabling automated browser-based testing, debugging, and performance analysis through AI-assisted workflows.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman — Claude Code Skill That Cuts 65% of Tokens by Talking Like Caveman
items.title_zh: JuliusBrussee/caveman — 用原始人说话方式为Claude Code节省65% tokens的技能
items.summary: A creative Claude Code skill that reduces token consumption by 65% by using minimalist, caveman-like language in system prompts. The project demonstrates how prompt engineering can significantly reduce API costs without sacrificing functionality.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — Compact 0.6B Parameter Conversational Model with 28M+ Downloads
items.title_zh: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — 下载量超2800万的0.6B参数紧凑型对话模型
items.summary: Qwen3-0.6B, the smallest model in Alibaba's Qwen3 family, has accumulated over 28 million downloads with strong community adoption for edge deployment and lightweight conversational applications.

items.title: BAAI/bge-m3 — Multilingual Embedding Model with 32M+ Downloads and Strong Cross-Lingual Performance
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 下载量超3200万的多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BAAI's bge-m3 multilingual embedding model continues to dominate with over 32 million downloads, offering strong cross-lingual retrieval performance and serving as a foundational component in RAG pipelines worldwide.

items.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
items.title_zh: Embodied.cpp：面向异构机器人的具身AI模型可移植推理运行时
items.summary: Researchers present Embodied.cpp, a portable inference runtime that enables embodied AI models (including VLA and world-action models) to run across heterogeneous robot platforms without model-specific Python stacks or robot-side glue code, addressing a key deployment fragmentation problem.

items.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic Pretraining for VLAs
items.title_zh: 先学移动再学做：视觉-语言-动作模型的无任务预训练
items.summary: Addressing the scarcity of expert demonstration data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this paper proposes task-agnostic pretraining focused on learning movement primitives before task-specific skills, reducing the data bottleneck in robot learning.

items.title: HaloGuard 1.0: An Open Weights Constitutional Classifier for Multilingual AI Safety
items.title_zh: HaloGuard 1.0：面向多语言AI安全的开源权重宪法分类器
items.summary: HaloGuard 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art prompt safety classification at one-tenth the model size of leading alternatives (0.8B parameters), with best average F1 of 90.9 across seven benchmarks and support for 46 languages, released as open weights.

items.title: 3DLS: A 3D Logic-Stacked Architecture for Disaggregated LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 3DLS：面向分离式LLM服务的3D逻辑堆叠架构
items.summary: 3DLS proposes a 3D-stacked chiplet architecture that physically isolates KV-cache transfers from tensor parallelism collectives using vertical interconnects, achieving up to 1.49x throughput improvement and 60.2% lower end-to-end latency for disaggregated LLM serving.

items.title: LIB-TRAP: Standard Cell Library Hardware Trojan Risk Assessment and Prevention
items.title_zh: LIB-TRAP：标准单元库硬件木马风险评估与防护
items.summary: This work investigates a novel hardware security threat model where standard cell libraries are considered untrusted and can embed hardware Trojans. Using the Saed32nm and Sky130nm process design kits, the authors demonstrate stealthy Trojan insertion and propose risk assessment methods.

items.title: Approximate Attention Weighting for Sustainable FPGA-Based Vision Transformer Inference
items.title_zh: 面向可持续FPGA视觉Transformer推理的近似注意力加权
items.summary: A BRAM-free approximate attention-weighting unit for FPGA-based ViT inference that uses a 16-segment piecewise-linear function to approximate softmax, implemented on a Xilinx Zynq-7020 using only 1444 LUTs and no BRAM, with accuracy within 0.20% top-1 difference from exact softmax.
